n: Number of signals (first buys) of this wallet in the selection period
raw: Share of signals that hit (fast: ×2 within 1 h; picker: pool or ×5 in 24 h, ≥×1.5 from our entry)
p_exp: Expected hit rate for a random buyer at the same curve positions as this wallet
low: Wilson 80% lower bound of the hit rate — the pessimistic reading
excess: Lower bound minus expected: the edge over the market. The main criterion.
lift: Raw hit rate divided by expected
rug: Share of signals where the price fell below 0.2× within 10 minutes
med_rank: Median position among the token’s buyers (5 = usually the 5th buyer)
med_curve_frac: Median share of the graduation threshold already collected when the wallet bought
med_ath_1h: Median peak within 1 h relative to our entry 2 s after the wallet
med_t_ath_1h: Median time from entry to the 1-hour peak
mean_ath_24h: Mean peak within 24 h — sensitive to the tail (×10+)
best_share_24h: Share of the wallet’s total 24 h gain coming from its single best signal (lower = more consistent)
grad_rate: Share of the wallet’s tokens that graduated to a pool
p_x5_24h: Share of signals reaching ×5 within 24 h
val_n: Signals in the validation period (last 7 days, not used for selection)
val_raw: Hit rate on the validation period — the number that catches luck
flag: contract = address has code; check-code / eoa-bot = suspected bot
